description: An unparenthesized heredoc can't be an object key, since the line break after it ends the element
notes: The grammar allows any expression as a key, and the prose says newlines between the braces are ignored as whitespace, so = can follow on the line after the closing marker. hashicorp/hcl's scanner emits the line break after the closing marker as a separate newline token (the heredocLiteralEOL action in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl), and parseObjectCons in hclsyntax/parser.go treats it as the end of the element, before its =, as it does any newline inside an object constructor. Inside parentheses, where newlines are ignored, a heredoc key works.
